author: KeewiDood
body:
Title basically explains it all. My brother who carries the IGN ''F2McLarenF2'' got permantly banned off the server for hacking. If he indeed did hack could you provide sufficient evidence? He is indeed banned as you can see at www.avicus.net/f2mclarenf2 and he does not have a forum account. Thanks for your time and I hope that we can get this issue resolved!



-Kevin
